label: Mecca outer districts (notional theatre)

urban_bounds.rationale: Ordinary outer districts and the settlements along the valley roads west of the historic centre, ~18 x 22 km, inside the AOI and outside every protected zone's buffer; the nearest point is more than 4 km from the Masjid al-Haram precinct. OpenStreetMap maps few building footprints here, so residential streets are drawn as well: the street grid is mapped where the buildings are not. No religious site is inside it, and places of worship are left out of the layer entirely.

regions.name: rugged hills and wadis west of the outer districts
ridges south of the outer districts
foothills north of the outer districts

notes: Ambience regions are coarse, hand-drawn open relief west and south of the outer districts, on the far side of the city from the historic centre; no place, facility or road was consulted to draw them. Every protected zone lies east of the AOI and carries the ambience policy with its buffer and a 1.5 km margin.
